method.processes: Before and after were separate Python invocations loading the then-current working-tree story.py through importlib.util; no isolated git checkout was measured.
method.invocation: For i in range(8): start = time.perf_counter(); story.Book.create(root / str(i), "初始化合成夹具", "long"); elapsed = time.perf_counter() - start
method.directories: Each phase used its own TemporaryDirectory; each numbered book directory was previously absent. The temporary root was resolved before use.
method.trace: Before timing, each phase created one additional untimed book with sqlite3.set_trace_callback. CREATE statement counts and in_transaction were observed there; after also counted the explicit COMMIT. Timed calls did not install a trace callback.
method.durability: No synchronous or journal-mode setting was changed. The before method executes schema outside an explicit transaction; the after method runs schema plus initial metadata inside one BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction.
method.limitations: Eight sequential local samples per phase, with no cache flush, randomized interleaving, or Windows execution; not an account of total CI time or physical disk operations.
